packages/core/src/bots/bot-messages.prom.name: Bot message prompts
packages/core/src/bots/bot-messages.prom.description: Renders teammate and group rosters, the wake prompt per intent and the deliberation guidance.

packages/core/src/bots/bot-mentions.ts.name: Created-bot mentions
packages/core/src/bots/bot-mentions.ts.description: Folds new-bot announcement messages into the same bot's next reply.

packages/core/src/peers/peer-messages.ts.name: Peer transcript builder
packages/core/src/peers/peer-messages.ts.description: Builds per-peer conversations from sent and received bot-message blocks and unechoed replies.

packages/core/src/peers/peer-exchanges.t.name: Peer exchange lines
packages/core/src/peers/peer-exchanges.t.description: Merges consecutive peer messages into one counted chip line and finds replies never echoed as sends.

packages/core/src/peers/peer-history.ts.name: Peer history loader
packages/core/src/peers/peer-history.ts.description: Pages a peer thread's history with per-page and total timeouts and cancellation.

packages/core/src/composer/group-mention.name: Group mention routing
packages/core/src/composer/group-mention.description: Resolves which group members a message wakes from chips, @names and everyone aliases.

packages/adapters/src/bots/group-handoff.name: Group handoff
packages/adapters/src/bots/group-handoff.description: Hands a group stage to another member in one transaction and loads group and roster prompts.

packages/adapters/src/bots/group-post.ts.name: Post to group
packages/adapters/src/bots/group-post.ts.description: Posts a bot's message into one of its groups without waking any member.

packages/adapters/src/bots/agent-connect.name: Cross-owner agent links
packages/adapters/src/bots/agent-connect.description: Requests and approves bot-to-bot connections across Spaces and routes messages over them.

packages/adapters/src/tasks/background-h.name: Subagent prompts
packages/adapters/src/tasks/background-h.description: Builds the helper brief, the untrusted result prompt and the start and limit notes.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/tools/p.name: Subagent limits
packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/tools/p.description: Sets the four-helper parallel cap and clips a helper result to a character limit.

packages/adapters/src/runs/tools/run-too.name: Messaging tool handlers
packages/adapters/src/runs/tools/run-too.description: Handles message_bot, handoff_to_bot, run_subagent and agent tools, including file passing.

packages/adapters/src/runs/tools/run-too.name: Tool selection per run
packages/adapters/src/runs/tools/run-too.description: Chooses offered tools by run type, hiding messaging, fleet and delegation tools where unsafe.

packages/adapters/src/runs/lifecycle/use.name: Mid-turn progress
packages/adapters/src/runs/lifecycle/use.description: Limits progress messages and derives a bot-message outcome from final or progress text.

packages/adapters/src/runs/lifecycle/run.name: Delegated run origin
packages/adapters/src/runs/lifecycle/run.description: Walks delegation links to the authorizing run and rejects cancelled or removed origins.

packages/adapters/src/runs/assembly/sile.name: Silent reply sentinel
packages/adapters/src/runs/assembly/sile.description: Detects and strips the NO_RESPONSE reply so a run ends with no chat bubble.

packages/adapters/src/runs/assembly/run-.name: Reply guidance prompts
packages/adapters/src/runs/assembly/run-.description: Holds the guidance telling group members when to answer an unaddressed message.

packages/adapters/src/runs/assembly/run-.name: Run trust loaders
packages/adapters/src/runs/assembly/run-.description: Loads approval rules and the owner's own words, excluding bot and channel text.

packages/adapters/src/tools/builtin-flee.name: Fleet tool definitions
packages/adapters/src/tools/builtin-flee.description: Declares message_bot, handoff_to_bot, post_to_group, run_subagent and fleet tools with schemas.

packages/adapters/src/tools/schedule-too.name: Thread tool filter
packages/adapters/src/tools/schedule-too.description: Removes message_bot in group threads and hides routine-only tools from routine runs.

packages/db/src/spaces/groups.ts.name: Group repository
packages/db/src/spaces/groups.ts.description: Stores groups and members in call order and provides group locks and touch helpers.

packages/db/src/spaces/cross-space-commu.name: Cross-space check
packages/db/src/spaces/cross-space-commu.description: Locks two bots and allows messaging only in one Space or when both opted in.

packages/contracts/src/threads/message-b.name: Message block schema
packages/contracts/src/threads/message-b.description: Defines message blocks including bot messages, handoffs, subagent cards and intents.

apps/web/src/components/messages/Subagen.name: Subagent card
apps/web/src/components/messages/Subagen.description: Shows a helper's status, task and result in a foldable card with a stop button.

apps/web/src/pages/settings/PeerMessages.name: Peer messages overlay
apps/web/src/pages/settings/PeerMessages.description: Shows a read-only full-screen transcript of one bot-to-bot exchange.
